The 64-site cluster is the one of the row label 4x2^2x4, which also carries the paper's own mVMC -0.4924(2); periodic clusters (Hagymasi et al. state periodic boundary conditions). Implied, not stated (RULES.md 8): the sign. The cell prints '0.4923' without a minus. A traceless Hamiltonian has E0 <= 0, so a positive energy per site is impossible, and the magnitude sits beside the row's own -0.4924(2) and -0.4908(2); the column's other cells are negative. Only the negative reading fits. Hagymasi et al. print -0.4972(25) for the extrapolated 64-site energy (Table I), consistent with a non-extrapolated value above it.
